moments.title: Demi Lovato turns 34
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Demi Lovato, known for hits like 'Sorry Not Sorry' and their Disney Channel origins, celebrates their 34th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 34th Birthday to the incredible Demi Lovato! From Disney star to pop icon, what's your favourite Demi track?

angles.name: Voice & Hits
angles.copy: Turning 34 today, Demi Lovato! Their powerful vocals have given us so many anthems. Which one is on repeat for you?

moments.title: Robert Plant is 78
moments.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant, whose iconic voice defined a generation of rock music, celebrates his 78th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 78th Birthday to the one and only Robert Plant! What's your ultimate Led Zeppelin anthem?

angles.name: Iconic Voice
angles.copy: 78 years young! Robert Plant's voice is simply unmistakable. Celebrate his birthday by cranking up your favourite track featuring the rock god.

moments.title: Kelis turns 47
moments.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and chef Kelis, known for global hits like 'Milkshake' and 'Trick Me', celebrates her 47th birthday tomorrow, August 21st.

angles.name: Milkshake Maestro
angles.copy: Your milkshake brings all the listeners to the yard! Happy 47th Birthday for tomorrow to the fantastic Kelis. What's your top Kelis track?

angles.name: R&B Icon
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate Kelis's 47th birthday tomorrow! An R&B icon with a unique sound. What's your favourite era of her music?

moments.title: James Corden is 48
moments.blurb: British actor, comedian, writer, and former Late Late Show host James Corden, famous for 'Gavin & Stacey' and 'Carpool Karaoke', turns 48 on Saturday, August 22nd.

angles.name: Gavin & Stacey Star
angles.copy: From Barry Island to Hollywood! James Corden turns 48 on Saturday. What's your favourite Gavin & Stacey moment?

angles.name: Carpool King
angles.copy: Happy 48th for Saturday to James Corden! The man who got every celeb singing in his car. Who was his best Carpool Karaoke guest?

moments.title: Julian Casablancas turns 48
moments.blurb: The Strokes' enigmatic frontman Julian Casablancas, a key figure in the 2000s indie rock revival, celebrates his 48th birthday on Sunday, August 23rd.

angles.name: Indie Icon
angles.copy: Happy 48th Birthday to The Strokes' legendary frontman, Julian Casablancas, this Sunday! What's the ultimate Strokes track?

angles.name: Garage Rock King
angles.copy: Turning 48 on Sunday, Julian Casablancas defined a sound for a generation. Time to blast some early 00s indie rock in his honour!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals begin
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading and Leeds Festivals kick off next weekend, running from Thursday, August 27th to Sunday, August 30th, featuring a huge lineup of rock, indie, and pop acts.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: It's almost time! Reading & Leeds Festivals start next Thursday. Who are you most excited to see on the lineup?

angles.name: Ready to Rock
angles.copy: Four days of music, mud, and mayhem! Reading & Leeds kick off on the 27th. What's your festival essential?

angles.name: Yorkshire's Big Gig
angles.copy: Leeds Festival is just around the corner, starting next Thursday! Get ready for a huge weekend of music at Bramham Park.

moments.title: Shania Twain turns 61
moments.blurb: Country-pop icon Shania Twain, known as the 'Queen of Country Pop' with hits like 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!', celebrates her 61st birthday next Thursday, August 28th.

angles.name: Country Queen
angles.copy: Let's go girls! Shania Twain turns 61 next Thursday. What's your favourite song from the Queen of Country Pop?

angles.name: Timeless Tunes
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday for next week to Shania Twain! Her music still sounds as fresh as ever. Which track always gets you singing?

moments.title: Florence Welch is 40
moments.blurb: Florence + The Machine frontwoman Florence Welch, celebrated for her powerful vocals and unique indie sound, turns 40 next Thursday, August 28th.

angles.name: Indie Icon at 40
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the phenomenal Florence Welch next Thursday! Her voice is pure magic. What’s your favourite Florence + The Machine song?

angles.name: Dog Days Over
angles.copy: Turning 40 next week, Florence Welch has given us some truly iconic anthems. Which one are you playing to celebrate?

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: The Summer Bank Holiday is just around the corner on Monday 31st August! What are your big plans for the long weekend?

angles.name: Last Taste of Summer
angles.copy: Make the most of it! The Summer Bank Holiday is almost here, signalling the unofficial end of summer. How are you soaking up those last rays?

angles.name: Devon Bank Holiday
angles.copy: Devon, get ready for a long weekend! The Summer Bank Holiday is on Monday 31st August. Where's your favourite spot to enjoy it?
